test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The difference between compound interest and simple interest on Rs. X at 7.5% per annum for 2 years is Rs. 22.50. Find the value of X.
solution:
**Given:**

Compound interest (C.P) - simple interest (S.P) = Rs.22.5

Rate = 7.5% ; time = 2 years

**Concept used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)T

C.P = Amount (A) - principal (P)

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

Where, P = principal ; R = rate ; T = time

**Calculation:**

Let, principal (P) = X

C.P = Amount (A) - principal (P)

⇒ X × (1 + R/100)T - X

⇒ X × {(1 + 7.5/100)² - 1}

⇒ X × {(43/40)2 - 1}

⇒ X × {(1849/1600) - 1}

⇒ X × {249/1600}

⇒ 249X/1600------- (1)

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ (X × 7.5 × 2)/100

⇒ 15X/100

According to the question:

Compound interest (C.P) - simple interest (S.P) = Rs.22.5

⇒ 249X/1600 - 15X/100 = 22.5

⇒ (249X - 240X)/1600 = 22.5

⇒ 9X = (22.5 × 1600)

⇒ X = (22.5 × 1600)/9

⇒ X = 4000

∴ The correct answer is Rs.4000.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__****Concept used:**

For C.I:

Effective rate for 2 years = R + R + (R × R)/100

For S.I:

Effective rate for 2 years = R × 2

**Calculation:**

For C.I:

Effective rate for 2 years = 7.5 + 7.5 + (7.5 × 7.5)/100

⇒ 15 + 0.5625 = 15.5625%

For S.I:

Effective rate for 2 years = 7.5 × 2 = 15%

 According to the question:

Compound interest (C.P) - simple interest (S.P) = Rs.22.5

⇒ X × (15.5625% - 15%) = 22.5

⇒ X × 0.5625% = 22.5

⇒ X = (22.5 × 100)/0.5625

⇒ X = Rs.4000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.4000.**
